question: Identify the inference drawn from the passage.

options.text: There used to be life on Mars.
A minimal percentage of Mars expert believe there is life on Mars today.
There is life on Mars today.
There have been few discoveries about life on Mars

solution:
The correct answer is** 'A minimal percentage of Mars expert believe there is life on Mars today'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct inference drawn from the passage is: There is a possibility of past existence of life on Mars and a considerable number of scientists believe that Mars may have harbored life in the past.</str
